figurative_meaning_en: The beginning or initiation of any task, especially household chores like cooking
example_sentences_in_bangla: অফিসে তার হাতেখড়ি খুব সফল হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The new bride's first cooking session took place in the kitchen today.
His initiation into office work was very successful.
history: This idiom originates from traditional Bengali wedding customs where the bride performs her first cooking as a symbol of entering household responsibilities, often invoking Lakshmi for prosperity.
note: Commonly used in contexts of new beginnings in domestic life.
